bio: I'm Dika — a systems builder working where software engineering meets law and technology.

I care about how systems behave when things go wrong: explicit state, clear failure modes, and interfaces that stay usable on a small screen with a keyboard. Most of what I build ends up as web software, usually with TypeScript, React or Next.js.
The work is public on purpose. Every build here links to its source, says what is missing, and can be checked by someone who doesn't trust me.
